Wednesday, the 16th August, 2000/25 Sravana, 1922 (Saka) 
The House met at eleven of the clock, 
MR. CHAIRMAN in the Chair. 
OBITUARY REFERENCE 
MR. CHAIRMAN: Hon, Members, I refer with profound sorrow to 
the passing away of Shri KG. Bhutia, a sitting Member of this House on the 
12th August, 2000, at the age of 60. Shri Bhutia was ailing for quite some 
time and was undergoing treatment and we thought that he was on his way to 
recovery but God willed otherwise. 
Born at Kabi (Sikkim) in September, 1940, Shri Bhutia was 
educated at Kalimpong, West Bengal. An agriculturist by vocation, Shri 
Bhutia was associated with various social and cultural organisations. Shri 
Bhutia was a Member of the First Sikkim Legislative Assembly from 1974 to 
1979 and Third Sikkim Legislative Assembly from 1984 to 1989. Shri Bhutia 
also held the- office of Deputy Speaker of Sikkim Legislative Assembly from 
1977 to 1979. 
Shri Bhutia represented the State of Sikkim in Rajya Sabha from 
February, 2000 till the date of his death. 
In the passing away of Shri Bhu tia, the country has lost a noted 
social worker. 
We deeply mourn the passing away of Shri KG. Bhutia. 
I request the Members to rise in their places and observe silence as a 
mark of respect to the memory of the departed. 
(Hon. Members then stood in silence for one minute.) 1 

RAJYA   SABHA [ 16 August, 2000 ] 
MR. CHAIRMAN: Secretary-General will convey to the members 
of the bereaved family our sense of profound sorrow and deep sympathy. 
As a mark of respect to the departed soul, the House is adjourned 
for the day, to meet at 11.00 a.m. tomorrow. 
The House then adjourned at two minutes past eleven of the clock, till 
eleven of the clock on Thursday, the 17th August, 2000
